submitted_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' THEN total END) - SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' THEN total END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2024-01-01' THEN total END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.billing_country = 'Brazil' AND invoice_date >= DATE '2023-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01';
validated_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) THEN total END) - SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) THEN total END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) THEN total END), 0) AS yoy_growth_rate FROM public.invoice AS i JOIN public.customer AS c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.billing_country = 'Brazil' AND invoice_date >= CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
